findings.source_quote: Dominance of certain plants like thorns and thistles
findings.suggested_fix: Translate phrase using correct Kiswahili plant terms and sense. Example: “Utegemeo wa mimea fulani kama vishoka na magugu ya thistle” or better “Ukimomonyoka wa mimea fulani kama vishoka na magugu (thistles)” preserving meaning that certain thorny plants became dominant.
findings.translation_quote: Utegemeo wa mimea fulani kama vishawishi na vidonge

findings.location: Section heading ("Dominance of Thorns and Thistles")
findings.suggested_fix: Use an accurate Kiswahili heading that reflects the English meaning. Example: “Uinukufu wa Visho na Magugu ya Thistle” or “Utegemeo wa Visho na Magugu (Thistles)” to convey dominance of thorny plants.

findings.location: Paragraph under "Distress and Pain" (list of remedies)
findings.source_quote: From ancient times, plants, herbs, and other remedies have helped people deal with pain and distress.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the incorrect word “nyanya” (tomato) with an appropriate Kiswahili word for herbs/medicinal plants. Example: “Tangu nyakati za kale, mimea, mimea ya kutibu, na tiba nyingine zimewasaidia watu kushughulikia maumivu na dhiki.”
findings.translation_quote: Tangu nyakati za kale, mimea, nyanya, na tiba nyingine zimewasaidia watu kushughulikia maumivu na dhiki.

findings.source_quote: Ruins of Hiroshima after the atomic bombing
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the alt-text translation to match the English. Example: “Magofu ya Hiroshima baada ya bomu la atomiki” (the original English used the plural "Ruins"; the current translation uses the plural but word choice could be tightened). The current translation "Magofu ya Hiroshima baada ya bomu la atomiki" is acceptable; if a change is desired: “Magofu ya Hiroshima baada ya upigaji bomu la atomiki.”
findings.translation_quote: Magofu ya Hiroshima baada ya bomu la atomiki

findings.suggested_fix: Translate the alt text to accurately describe the image. Current translation “Gurudumu la artichokes za kijani” is unnatural ("gurudumu" = wheel). Use: “Safu ya artichokes za kijani” or “Kingi ya artichokes za kijani.”
